rows.grounds: bahuvrihi compound mukta-keśa-śiras; describes a figure whose head has loosened hair
compound vikīrṇa-keśa-saṃyuta; describes one furnished with disheveled hair

items.question: Which hair-disheveled figures are included among the enumerated ominous apparitions?
premises: The verse names a figure with loose hair on the head.
The verse names a figure endowed with scattered hair.
These figures continue the preceding list of ominous signs.
items.inference: Disheveled-haired figures are counted among the ominous apparitions in this sequence.
uncertainties: The exact referent of the figures is not specified within this verse alone.
items.plain_english: And indeed one with loose hair on the head, and one endowed with scattered hair.
